parts.partTitle: Security Requirements Relating to the Properties of Products with Digital Elements

requirements.clause: Design and development with an appropriate level of cybersecurity based on risk.
requirements.description: Products shall be delivered without known exploitable vulnerabilities and with secure-by-default configurations.

requirements.clause: Protection of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data.
requirements.description: State-of-the-art cryptographic mechanisms, data-in-transit and data-at-rest protection, and strict access controls.

requirements.clause: Attack surface minimization and principle of least privilege.
requirements.description: Disabling unused ports, services, and debug interfaces by default.

requirements.clause: Vulnerability identification, internal triage, and coordinated disclosure (CVD).
requirements.description: Manufacturers must operate a dedicated vulnerability reporting channel and establish a documented PSIRT policy.

requirements.clause: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and maintenance.
requirements.description: Machine-readable SBOM identifying all direct and transitive third-party dependencies in CycloneDX or SPDX format.

requirements.clause: Regular security testing and vulnerability scanning.
requirements.description: Automated regression testing, static and dynamic analysis, and security updates testing.

annexes.title: Information and Instructions to the User

requirements.clause: Clear point of contact for vulnerability reporting.
requirements.description: Public email or portal for security researchers and end-users.
Explicit month and year marking the end date of vulnerability patch availability.

requirements.clause: Secure decommissioning and data sanitization instructions.
requirements.description: Steps required to safely wipe credentials and configurations when retiring hardware.

annexes.title: Important Products with Digital Elements (Class I & Class II)
classI: Identity management systems and privileged access management software
Software for vulnerability detection, asset discovery and endpoint protection
Network interfaces and virtual network switches (e.g. Scalance, Hirschmann, Cisco IE)
Routers, modems intended for internet connection, and industrial switches
Microcontrollers and integrated circuits with general-purpose instruction sets
classII: Industrial firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS)
Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Distributed Control Systems (DCS), and RTUs
Smart meter gateways and advanced industrial sensor controllers

annexes.title: Critical Products with Digital Elements
products: Hardware devices with security boxes and smartcard chips
Secure microcontrollers used in European Digital Identity Wallets
Hardware components with integrated cryptographic coprocessors evaluated at EAL4+

annexes.title: EU Declaration of Conformity (Model Structure)
mandatoryFields: 1. Product name, model, type, batch or serial number
2. Name and address of manufacturer or authorized representative
3. Object of declaration (identification of product allowing traceability)
4. Statement of conformity with Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 and harmonised standards applied
5. Identification of Notified Body (name, number) and EU-type examination certificate where applicable
6. Signed for and on behalf of manufacturer (place, date, name, function, signature)

modules.name: Internal Control (Self-Assessment)
modules.applicableFor: Default products with digital elements without high risk.

modules.name: Comprehensive Quality Assurance by Notified Body
modules.applicableFor: Important Class II and Critical products.

modules.name: EU-Type Examination (B) followed by Conformity to Type (C)
modules.applicableFor: Important Class I (alternative) and Important Class II products.

annexes.title: Technical Documentation (Contents of Technical File)
elements: General description of the product and cybersecurity intended purpose
Cybersecurity risk assessment report identifying threats and vulnerability vectors
System architecture diagrams, data flow models, and trust boundaries
Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) and third-party component provenance ledger
Test reports, static analysis findings, penetration test results, and vulnerability remediation records

annexes.title: Correlation Table & Directive Alignment
crossDirectives: Directive 2014/53/EU (Radio Equipment Directive - RED Delegated Act)
Directive (EU) 2022/2555 (NIS2 Directive Art. 21 supply chain duties)
